components.rationale: The rendered sheet displays the axiom schemas A1-A3 (lines 11-13) and the quantifier schemas forall1, forall2 with x not in FV(phi), exists1 (15-17), MP (14), the existential-elimination rule with its two conditions (18) and Gen with the dependency-sensitive restriction 'x is not free in any premise of Gamma on which the derivation of phi depends; unrestricted when phi is derived from no premises' (19). The dependency sets are defined at first-order-calculi-supplement.tex 54-83 and linked from the sheet (21-22); P14 168-174 restates the three variable checks. Same named system (Hilbert calculus for classical first-order logic, equality convention stated); no old artifact relied on.

The registry file, rendered in full with the sheet at P14 line 176, now states the deduction theorem on the sheet (Gamma u {phi} |- psi iff Gamma |- phi -> psi, lines 23-25), states its free-variable restriction (Gen and existential elimination may be applied to a line whose support contains phi only when the rule's variable is not free in phi, lines 25-28), links the theorem, the dependency definition and both proofs (21-30), and excludes unrestricted generalization of a premise-dependent line (30-31). The linked targets exist on route: statement at supplement 85-97, proof at the supplement annex 21-59 and the case-by-case written derivations at the w02-p02-025 annex 168-328. This closes the September record's 'the sheet does not state/link the theorem'.
